label: Episode 30
logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her.

CLIP: episode 30, 1 segment(s), 25s
[00:33.60-00:39.80] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous): "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
[00:39.80-00:43.80] CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
[00:41.80-00:43.50] RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive): "What are you suggesting?"
[00:43.80-00:47.60] CAMERA: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
[00:44.80-00:47.30] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous): "We stop hiding the prisoner."
[00:47.60-00:51.00] CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
[00:48.00-00:50.50] SOUND: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
[00:51.00-00:54.60] CAMERA: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
[00:51.20-00:54.00] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister): "We give them a reason to condemn her."
[00:54.60-00:58.80] CAMERA: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.
[00:57.00-00:58.80] CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp): "You have a solution?"
[00:58.80-00:59.05] CAMERA: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

CLIP: episode 30, 1 segment(s), 33s
[01:29.00-01:31.30] RUPERT (Stunned): "Witchcraft is a capital charge."
[01:31.80-01:34.50] CAMERA: Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.
[01:32.00-01:33.40] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching): "Precisely."
[01:34.50-01:41.90] CAMERA: Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.
[01:34.60-01:41.80] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command): "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."
[01:41.90-01:44.40] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.
[01:42.20-01:43.90] CATHERINE (Scheming): "Her botanical ledger..."
[01:44.40-01:46.60] CAMERA: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.
[01:44.80-01:46.00] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Confirming): "Exactly."
[01:46.60-01:49.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.
[01:47.30-01:48.80] CATHERINE (Inquiring): "And the Dowager?"
[01:49.00-01:56.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
[01:49.50-01:56.50] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive): "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
[01:56.80-02:01.75] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.
[02:00.00-02:01.50] RUPERT (Hesitant): "And Juliana?"
